description: Approved identity/email plan step1. Canonical identity unique by platform/authority/native ID, separate connector links. Necessary schema only: no WIP data repair/backfill/duplicate reconciliation. Subsequent steps recipient discovery, email threads/reply-all/listing and fresh DB validation remain approved. Preserve unrelated work; no git publication.
title: Standardize external Person identity independently of connector links
